$comment: Real-data signature list for the build-stage data-hygiene check (task 6.16, ING-19). 'markers' are regular expressions that identify raw provider (Yahoo Finance) payloads; 'row_sha256' holds SHA-256 hashes of '<instrument>|<YYYY-MM-DD>|<close>' strings computed from retrieved beta data by an operator (hashes only, never values; empty until phase 2). A committed fixture that matches either list fails the build.
